My dear [Alice](/person/1025),
[I](/person/1606) wrote instantly to thank [Dr. Moberly](/person/1015) for his good news, but the cart was missed on Sunday morning. Tell us if [Margaret](/person/83) has seen [the brother](/person/1026)[^1], and what she said of him, and tell us who the boy is like and whether he is large or small, dark or fair. Three days of well-doing make us think you will soon be ready for ‘[Heartsease](/book/19)’; there will be plenty for you to begin upon. I am bent upon Charlotte seeing all she can of [Bishop Selwyn](/person/1295), and trust to Dr. Moberly to manage it for her, and must have her see [Mrs. Selwyn](/person/1297) somehow.


[^1]: Selwyn William Moberly (1854-1871), seventh son and youngest of the Moberlys\' fifteen children, was christened on 8 June 1854.
